name: Find and edit guidance
description: Verifies searchable guidance can be updated and remains saved in the browser.
steps: Open the matching article for editing
Change its title to 'Team layer rules' and save
expected: The updated article appears in the library after refresh, with its category and tags retained.

name: Create and complete a drawing review checklist
description: Verifies a reusable checklist can be created, run, and completed.
steps: Build a checklist named 'Sheet issue check' with two steps
expected: The checklist is saved, its progress reaches 2 of 2, and the review complete message appears.

name: Filter guidance and clear an empty result on mobile
description: Checks mobile search and recovery from a query with no matches.
steps: Open CAD guidance on a mobile viewport
Verify the empty result message appears
expected: The empty state appears for the unmatched query, then the guidance cards return after clearing filters.

name: Reject incomplete guidance without losing existing content
description: Ensures required article fields prevent incomplete guidance from being saved.
steps: Open Manage and choose Add guidance
Enter a title but leave the short description and guidance empty
expected: The form requires the missing fields and no incomplete article is added to the library.
